# WhiteMagic

> Local-first memory and session continuity for coding agents, over MCP. Rust, MIT, no telemetry, no cloud service. Records what matters, finds it after restart, and carries decisions into the next session — on your machine.

WhiteMagic gives an AI coding agent durable project memory: explicit MCP routes, lexical search without an external model, session record/replay, cross-session continuity, an install/host-health selftest, and Linux Landlock containment. Trusted, local, single-user operation. Truthful degradation when optional models are unavailable.

## Install

One-line installer (resolves the latest release, verifies the checksum):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://www.whitemagic.dev/install.sh?ref=gen3-llms | sh
```

Or download the binary from the [latest release](https://github.com/lbailey94/whitemagic/releases), verify with `sha256sum -c`, and move it to `~/.local/bin/wm`.

## Connect an MCP client

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "whitemagic": {
      "command": "wm",
      "args": ["serve", "--profile", "cyberbrain"]
    }
  }
}
```

The server speaks stdio JSON-RPC. `cyberbrain` (default) exposes 12 lean tools
including the `wm` meta-tool; `full` exposes the 40-route curated catalog plus
any feature-gated routes the build registered (`wm contract --json` reports the
exact set). Explicit routing is the dependable contract.

## Hosted lanes (read-only beta)

A read-only hosted MCP endpoint for evaluation runs lives at
<https://mcp.whitemagic.dev/mcp> (streamable-http; keyless
`initialize`/`tools/list` for directory probes; free evaluation keys via
whitemagic.dev/contact; no SLA). The hosted store is curated public content
only — your local memory store is never uploaded. A stateless
receipt-verification API runs at <https://api.whitemagic.dev> (`/health` and
`/info` keyless; keyed `POST /verify` for continuity-receipt bundles).

## Verify

```bash
wm --version        # Gen3 10.2.x-alpha line
wm selftest --json  # install invariant + host_status/host_health
wm selftest --strict  # exit 1 only when the host verdict is critical
```
